name: Circleback
description: Bring context from Circleback into Claude. Search and access meeting notes, transcripts, calendar events, emails, people, companies, and more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Circleback to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Circleback to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://circleback.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Circleback MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Circleback provides these MCP tools: SearchMeetings, SearchTranscripts, GetTranscriptsForMeetings, ReadMeetings, FindProfiles, FindDomains, SearchCalendarEvents, SearchEmails, and SearchSupportArticles.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Circleback?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Circleback in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Circleback requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Circleback is developed by Circleback. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
